reason: The  owner directive (2026-08-25) retired the measured-heavy marker; the one test whose entire claim was a property OF that marker (a module fixture cost cannot escape the per-PR exclusion via a cheap sibling) became vacuous with it — -m heavy collects nothing, so the assertion could no longer fail. Surviving coverage: module fixture costs stay recorded in the manifest (# module-cost: rows), printed in the per-tier audit totals, and inside the ratchet accounting.
